_guide: HOW TO ADD / EDIT A CONTRIBUTOR
This file is read LIVE from the repository (branch main) every time
the Contributors screen opens in the app, so there is no need to rebuild
the APK to change it: edit THIS file, commit and push it, and the app picks
the change up on the next launch of the Contributors screen. A copy of
this file is also bundled inside the APK as an offline fallback.
Each entry inside "contributors" looks like this:
"username": "octocat",
"name": "Octo Cat",
"description": "One sentence on how this person contributes.",
"url": "https://github.com/octocat"
Fields:
- "username": GitHub handle (REQUIRED). The avatar is fetched automatically
from GitHub by this username.
- "name": the person's real name (optional). When set it is shown FIRST as
"Octo Cat (@octocat)"; when missing only "@octocat" is shown.
- "description": short neutral-English text (not translated by the app).
Keep it on a single line inside the quotes.
- "url": optional; defaults to https://github.com/<username> when missing.
Notes:
- The order in the file is the order shown in the Contributors screen.
- Add people by inserting a new object between the { } of the contributors
array (mind the comma after the previous entry).
